missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Надпись' is the feminine nominative subject of 'была', which agrees in feminine gender. 'Странная' is the agreeing adjective, and 'на стене' locates it. A vivid scene.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Надпись' stays nominative as the subject of 'читается'. 'Эта' points at a specific one, and 'совсем не' negates. A practical everyday complaint.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Надпись' is the accusative direct object of 'прочитал'; this soft-sign feminine noun keeps its form in the accusative singular. 'Старую' agrees, a clean object example.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Надписи' is the genitive form showing whose meaning it is. 'Смысла' is itself genitive after the negated verb, a useful layered example.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Надписи' is the dative form after 'к' to express movement toward. 'Любопытный турист' is the nominative subject, a natural museum scene.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Надписью' is the instrumental form after 'над' to express location above. 'Старый портрет' is the nominative subject, a tidy spatial description.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На надписи' uses the prepositional form after 'на' to mean on the inscription. 'Старая дата' is the nominative subject, a natural detail.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Надписи' is the nominative plural subject of the short form 'видны'. 'Древние' agrees in the plural, and 'на камнях' locates them. A clear plural example.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Надписи' is the accusative plural object of 'изучают'; inanimate feminine plurals share nominative and accusative forms. 'Старинные' agrees. A scholarly line.
